-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Name of the service, job, or task group

run.Name: run
run.description: Run a one-off task on Amazon ECS

--build-context.Name: --build-context
--build-context.description: Path to the Docker build context

--cluster.Name: --cluster
--cluster.description: Optional. The short name or full ARN of the cluster to run the task in

--command.Name: --command
--command.description: Optional. The command that is passed to "docker run" to override the default command

--count.Name: --count
--count.description: Optional. The number of tasks to set up

--cpu.Name: --cpu
--cpu.description: Optional. The number of CPU units to reserve for each task

--default.Name: --default
--default.description: Optional. Run tasks in default cluster and default subnets

--entrypoint.Name: --entrypoint
--entrypoint.description: Optional. The entrypoint that is passed to "docker run" to override the default entrypoint

--env-vars.Name: --env-vars
--env-vars.description: Optional. Environment variables specified by key=value separated by commas

--execution-role.Name: --execution-role
--execution-role.description: Optional. The ARN of the role that grants the container agent permission to make AWS API calls

--follow.Name: --follow
--follow.description: Optional. Specifies if the logs should be streamed

--generate-cmd.Name: --generate-cmd
--generate-cmd.description: Optional. Generate a command with a pre-filled value for each flag. To use it for an ECS service, specify --generate-cmd <cluster name>/<service name>. Alternatively, if the service or job is created with Copilot, specify --generate-cmd <application>/<environment>/<service or job name>. Cannot be specified with any other flags

--image.Name: --image
--image.description: The location of an existing Docker image

--memory.Name: --memory
--memory.description: Optional. The amount of memory to reserve in MiB for each task

--platform-arch.Name: --platform-arch
--platform-arch.description: Optional. Architecture of the task. Must be specified along with 'platform-os'

--platform-os.Name: --platform-os
--platform-os.description: Optional. Operating system of the task. Must be specified along with 'platform-arch'

--resource-tags.Name: --resource-tags
--resource-tags.description: Optional. Labels with a key and value separated by commas. Allows you to categorize resources

--secrets.Name: --secrets
--secrets.description: Optional. Secrets to inject into the container. Specified by key=value separated by commas

--security-groups.Name: --security-groups
--security-groups.description: Optional. The security group IDs for the task to use. Can be specified multiple times

--subnets.Name: --subnets
--subnets.description: Optional. The subnet IDs for the task to use. Can be specified multiple times

--tag.Name: --tag
--tag.description: Optional. The container image tag in addition to "latest"

--task-group-name.Name: --task-group-name
--task-group-name.description: Optional. The group name of the task.  Tasks with the same group name share the same set of resources.  (default directory name)

--task-role.Name: --task-role
--task-role.description: Optional. The ARN of the role for the task to use

-i.Name: -i
-i.description: The location of an existing Docker image

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Optional. The group name of the task.  Tasks with the same group name share the same set of resources.  (default directory name)
